column3: hello, hi, is this le mans
column4: Hi, thanks for calling LeMans Entertainment in Dandenong South. I can help with hours, activities, kids parties, bucks or group bookings. What can I do for you?
column5: What are you looking to book?
column7: Don't launch into a sales pitch.

column3: what time do you open, are you open today, closing time
column4: We're open seven days. Monday and Tuesday 9:45am to 5:30pm, Wednesday and Thursday 9:45am to 10pm, Friday 10:15am to 9pm, Saturday 9:15am to 11pm, Sunday 9:15am to 10pm. The bookings office is open from 9am every day. We can open earlier for pre-booked groups.
column5: Is this for a casual visit or a party?
column7: Don't quote the conflicting Friday 12:15 time unless staff update this sheet.

column3: where are you, address, how do I get there
column4: We're at 55 Waterview Close, Dandenong South, Victoria 3175. There's free on-site parking for cars and buses.
column5: Are you heading in today or booking ahead?

column3: is there parking, bus parking, coach
column4: Yes — free parking on site, including space for buses on the 23-acre complex.

column3: what activities, what's there
column4: LeMans is a whole entertainment precinct — outdoor go-karts, Zero Latency free-roam VR, lasertag, indoor mini golf, Arcadia arcade, plus a restaurant and licensed sports bar. Most groups mix two or three activities.
column5: Is it for kids, adults, bucks, or a work group?

column3: kids birthday, 8th birthday, party for my son
column4: We run kids parties for 6–8, 8–12 and teen 12–17. Packages can include mini or sprint karts, lasertag, VR, mini golf and arcade, with catering, a host and a reserved table. Minimum 8 guests including the birthday child, or 10 for go-kart parties. Weekends book out, and mid-week Wednesday to Friday is usually easier and cheaper outside school holidays.
column5: What age is the birthday child, roughly how many kids, and which date are you thinking?
column7: Do not guarantee a date until deposit is taken by a human.

column3: how much is a kids party
column4: Published kids go-kart party pricing starts around $39 off-peak and $49 peak per child, and combo packages are higher. Exact price depends on age, activities and day. I can put you through to reservations to lock it in — a non-refundable deposit for the minimum number holds the date.
column5: Want me to transfer you to reservations now?
column7: Treat prices as guide only until staff confirm current rate card.

column3: how do I book a party, deposit
column4: Bookings are made by calling reservations on (03) 8787 8741. A non-refundable deposit equal to the minimum guests holds the date — 8 people for VR, lasertag or mini golf parties, 10 for go-karting. Call one week before to finalise numbers, catering and the balance.

column3: does the party include food, pizza, nuggets, cake
column4: Kids party packages include catering — arancini, chicken nuggets, or margherita or Hawaiian pizza, with chips and a drink. Finalise food one week prior. You may bring a birthday cake no larger than a dinner plate, and lolly bags. No other BYO food. Dietary needs can usually be catered if you tell us when booking.
column5: Any allergies in the group?

column3: 13th, 16th, teen party
column4: Teen parties are built for 12–17s — sprint karts, VR, lasertag, mini golf or arcade. Same 8-guest minimum, or 10 for karts. Off-peak discounts apply mid-week.
column5: Age, headcount and preferred day?

column3: bucks, hens, stag, hens day
column4: Bucks and hens are one of our busiest products. You can mix super karts, VR, lasertag, mini golf and the sports bar. Published packages include Hang Out from $139 a person for smaller crews, Show Off at $199 a person for 10 or more with two super-kart races, 30 minutes of VR, two lasertag games, burger and a pot, host and trophies. Race-only packages start from $89 a person for 10 plus. Weekends go fast.
column5: How many people and which date?

column3: team building, work Christmas, company event
column4: We host everything from a handful of staff through to very large company days across karts, VR, lasertag and the bar. Packages are tailored. I'll put you through to the corporate team so they can hold dates.
column5: Company name, headcount and preferred date?
column7: Do not quote a corporate rate.

column3: how old for go karts, can my 7 year old race
column4: Mini karts are used for younger kids parties. Sprint karts suit older kids and teens. Super karts — our fastest — are 18 plus, or 16 plus with a valid learner permit that must be sighted, and photo ID for over 18s. Height and medical rules also apply. If they are close to the cutoff, reservations will check the exact track.
column5: How old are the drivers?

column3: laser tag age, is 5 too young
column4: Laserzone is for guests aged 6 and up. No minimum group size for casual play. Exclusive hire usually needs about 20 people.

column3: zero latency age, VR for kids
column4: VR age depends on the game. Engineerium is from 8, Singularity from 10, most action titles from 12, and Far Cry VR from 15. Sessions cap at 8 players. It is not suitable in pregnancy or some heart / mobility / injury cases.
column5: How old are the players and is it a party or casual?

column3: mini golf, arcade, arcadia
column4: Indoor mini golf is recommended from age 4, and under 4s can join free. Arcadia arcade is all-ages, recommended from 3. Enclosed shoes for mini golf.

column3: pregnant, epilepsy, bad back, heart, can I still race
column4: For safety we cannot take guests who are pregnant or who have epilepsy on the activities. Go-karts and VR also exclude a range of injuries, recent surgery, high blood pressure, heart conditions and back pain. I can't medically clear you on this call — email info@lemansgokarts.com.au or speak with reservations.

column3: what to wear, shoes, what to bring
column4: Enclosed shoes for every activity. No loose scarves on the track. Super-kart drivers need photo ID or a learner permit. Complete the online waiver from the confirmation email before you arrive for go-karts and VR. Under 18s need a parent or guardian signature.

column3: do I need a waiver, indemnity
column4: Yes for go-karts and Zero Latency VR. The link is in the confirmation email. Please complete it before you get here so the group isn't held at reception.

column3: need to change date, cancel party
column4: You can reschedule with at least 7 days' notice and the deposit transfers to the new date. Less notice than that, the deposit stays. No-shows can be credited only if you still meet minimum numbers and you told us 24 hours ahead. I can't move a booking myself — I'll put you through.
column5: What's the booking name and date?

column3: can we just turn up
column4: Casual lasertag, mini golf and arcade are the easiest walk-ups. Karts, VR and parties should be booked, especially Friday night through Sunday. I can check intent and take details for reservations.
column5: How many people and which activity?

column3: gift voucher, weekly deals, discount
column4: Gift cards and current weekly deals are on lemansentertainment.com.au. Mid-week kids party deals run Wednesday to Friday outside public and school holidays. I won't quote a discount that might have expired — reservations can apply what's live.
column5: Want the deals page or a transfer?

column3: school excursion, holiday program
column4: Yes we host school groups. That's a tailored booking — I'll take the school name, year level, headcount and date and pass it to reservations.
column5: School name and proposed date?

column3: I'm booked at 2, running late, where do I check in
column4: Check in at main reception at 55 Waterview Close. If you are running late I can take the name and time and pass it to the floor so they hold what they can. I can't delay a track session myself.
column5: Booking name and activity time?

column3: this is not good enough, I want a refund
column4: I'm sorry that happened. I want the right person to help. I can't process refunds on this line. Let me take your name and booking details and put you through to a manager.
column5: Name, date of visit, and best number?
column7: No admission of liability, no refund promise.

column3: call outside hours
column4: The venue and bookings office are closed right now. I can answer basic questions and take your details so reservations call you after 9am.
column5: Name, mobile, and what you want to book?
column7: Don't say a human is coming to the phone.
